title: osf verify becomes a moon-driven checkpoint runner
summary: This change replaces the in-process `osf verify` gate with a checkpoint runner: `osf verify --checkpoint <name>` selects the moon tasks tagged for that checkpoint, runs them over the affected file list, and journals one hash-chained verification event per task plus a checkpoint-complete event. Each check is now also callable on its own as `osf check <name>` over an explicit file list, reading content from the working tree at the hook checkpoint and from git `HEAD` everywhere else. Supporting this, the crate gains a moon adapter, a journal, git-hook installation, and hermetic git environment scrubbing so an inherited `GIT_DIR`/`GIT_INDEX_FILE` can no longer redirect a call aimed at another repository.

nodes.label: Git hooks
nodes.subtitle: pre-commit, pre-push, commit-msg
nodes.summary: The hook scripts now call `osf verify --checkpoint pre-commit` and `--checkpoint pre-push` instead of the old `--stage` form. `osf hooks install` writes them to a folder outside the repository and points `core.hooksPath` at it.

nodes.label: hook post-tool
nodes.subtitle: osf hook post-tool
nodes.summary: A new agent hook event: reads the written path from the tool event, resolves the repository holding it, runs the hook checkpoint on that one file, and refuses the write on an error finding.

nodes.label: osf CLI
nodes.subtitle: check, verify, hooks
nodes.summary: `osf check <name>` is new; `osf verify` now takes `--checkpoint` (with `--stage` kept as a deprecated alias) and delegates to the checkpoint runner. `osf hooks install` is new.

nodes.label: CI checkpoint job
nodes.subtitle: pull_request only
nodes.summary: A new workflow job builds osf, installs moon, and runs `osf verify --checkpoint pull-request --base origin/<base_ref>`, uploading the journal buffer and `.osf/out` as evidence.

nodes.label: checkpoint::run
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/checkpoint.rs
nodes.summary: Resolves the base and file list for the checkpoint, writes the `OSF_FILES_FROM` list and its hashes, takes the moon report lock, clears stale SARIF, runs the tagged moon target, and folds the report into a Summary.

nodes.label: Journal
nodes.subtitle: hash-chained JSONL
nodes.summary: Appends one verification event per task and one checkpoint-complete event per run to `<state_dir>/buffer/<run>.jsonl`, each chained to the previous by a SHA-256 hash that excludes wall-clock time, durations and cache state.

nodes.label: moon adapter
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/moon.rs
nodes.summary: Runs `moon run <targets> --affected --stdin`, parses `runReport.json` into per-task outcomes, reads each failed task's captured stdout/stderr tails, and queries `moon query tasks --tags` for the task and slot set.

nodes.label: check::run_check
nodes.subtitle: crates/osf/src/check.rs
nodes.summary: Runs one named check over an explicit file list, choosing content source by checkpoint: the working tree at the hook checkpoint, git `HEAD` at every other, and the index for `scan-staged`.

nodes.label: scan / scan-staged
nodes.subtitle: secret scanning
nodes.summary: The scan rules now run over a caller-supplied file list; `scan-staged` reads staged blobs from the index, `scan` reads disk at the hook checkpoint and `HEAD` elsewhere.

nodes.label: lint-writing
nodes.subtitle: prose lint
nodes.summary: Markdown files are linted from the checkpoint-appropriate content source, with the fixture `osf-expect` contract applied as before.

nodes.label: lint-skill
nodes.subtitle: SKILL.md and scripts
nodes.summary: Skill linting was split so the caller supplies `SKILL.md` text and script entries; the checkpoint runner passes committed content at pre-push and disk content at the hook.

nodes.label: scan-commits
nodes.subtitle: commit messages
nodes.summary: Scans every commit message in `base..HEAD` (or every commit reachable from `HEAD` when the base is the empty tree) for forbidden text.

nodes.label: .osf/moon.yml
nodes.subtitle: task definitions
nodes.summary: Defines one task per check per checkpoint, tagged `osf-hook`, `osf-pre-commit`, `osf-pre-push` or `osf-pull-request`, each declaring its inputs, its SARIF output, and a slot tag.

nodes.label: moon CLI
nodes.subtitle: pinned 2.5.5
nodes.summary: Installed by checksum in the devcontainer and by a composite CI action; the adapter refuses to run a moon older than 2.3.

nodes.label: git repository
nodes.subtitle: index, HEAD, refs
nodes.summary: Every git call is now scrubbed of inherited locating variables, and `GIT_INDEX_FILE` survives only when it lies inside the directory's own git dir. New helpers read staged blob hashes, files at a revision, and the upstream ref.

nodes.label: .osf/out/*.sarif
nodes.subtitle: per-task findings
nodes.summary: Each check task writes its findings as SARIF here; the runner deletes stale files before the run and reads them back to count findings and build refusal text.

edges.label: osf verify --checkpoint
edges.summary: The installed hook scripts exec `osf verify --checkpoint <name>`, which is the whole reason the runner exists.

edges.label: hook checkpoint on one file
edges.summary: The agent's post-tool hook runs the hook checkpoint over the single written file and refuses the write on failure.

edges.label: verify --checkpoint
edges.summary: `osf verify` resolves the checkpoint and hands a Request to the runner.

edges.label: osf check <name>
edges.summary: `osf check` loads config, resolves the file list from arguments or `OSF_FILES_FROM`, and runs one check.

edges.label: pull-request checkpoint
edges.summary: The CI job runs the pull-request checkpoint against the base branch and uploads the journal buffer and SARIF output.

edges.label: moon run :#<tag>
edges.summary: The runner hands the tagged target and the affected file list to the adapter, which spawns moon and parses its report.

edges.label: spawn
edges.summary: The adapter spawns the moon binary, stripping inherited `MOON_*` variables so a nested moon uses this workspace.

edges.label: reads task graph
edges.summary: moon reads `.osf/moon.yml` to decide which tasks the tag selects and which are affected by the stdin file list.

edges.label: osf check <name>
edges.summary: Each selected task's command is `osf check <name> --checkpoint <cp> --sarif-out ...`, so moon is what actually invokes the checks.

edges.label: HEAD / index content
edges.summary: Checks read file content from git `HEAD` or the index depending on the checkpoint, through the scrubbed git helpers.

edges.label: --sarif-out
edges.summary: Each check writes its findings as SARIF 2.1.0 to the path its moon task declares as an output.

edges.label: clear then read
edges.summary: The runner deletes stale SARIF before moon runs and reads the files back afterwards to count findings and build refusal text.

edges.label: one event per task
edges.summary: Every task outcome and the checkpoint total are appended to the run's hash-chained buffer file.

edges.label: base, files, hashes
edges.summary: The runner resolves the base ref, the changed or staged file list, and the index and commit-range fingerprints it passes to moon as inputs.

edges.label: runReport.json
edges.summary: moon writes one run report per workspace; the adapter holds a lock around it and parses it into per-task outcomes.

flows.title: A pre-push checkpoint run
flows.summary: What happens between `git push` and the journal entry: the hook calls verify, the runner resolves the pushed-to ref and the changed files, moon runs the tagged tasks, each task runs one check and writes SARIF, and the runner journals the outcome.

messages.label: resolve upstream ref and changed files
messages.note: With no explicit base, pre-push falls back to the ref it actually pushes against, and to the empty tree on a first push.

messages.label: moon run :#osf-pre-push --affected --stdin
messages.note: The file list reaches the tasks through OSF_FILES_FROM, not through moon's own arguments.

messages.label: osf check scan --checkpoint pre-push
messages.note: One invocation per task the tag selects; each reads its own file list and writes its own SARIF.

messages.label: SARIF findings
messages.note: Read back from .osf/out/<task>.sarif after moon exits, while the report lock is still held.

messages.label: verification + checkpoint-complete
messages.note: One verification event per task, then one checkpoint-complete event carrying the slot table.
